outline:
1. Analog Signals
a) Convolution
b) Fourier Series Expansion
c) Fourier Transform
d) Laplace Transform
2. Digital Signals
a) Discrete-time Fourier Transform
b) Z-transform
c) Discrete Fourier Series/Transform
3. Digital Systems
a) Linear Time-invariant Systems
b) Causality/Stability
c) Allpass/Minimum Phase systems
d) Structures for Digital System
4. Sampling Theory
a) A/D & D/A Conversion
b) Sampling Rate Conversion
5. Filter Design
a) Analog Filter
b) IIR Filter
c) FIR Filter
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction, Analog Signals
Week 2: Convolution
Week 3: Fourier Series Expansion, Fourier Transform, Laplace Transform
Week 4: Digital Signals
Week 5: Discrete-time Fourier Transform
Week 6: Z-transform
Week 7: Discrete Fourier Series/Transform
Week 8: Review
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10: Digital Systems, Linear Time-invariant Systems, Causality/Stability
Week 11: Allpass/Minimum Phase systems
Week 12: Structures for Digital System
Week 13: Sampling Theory
Week 14: A/D & D/A Conversion
Week 15: Sampling Rate Conversion
Week 16: Filter Design, Analog Filter
Week 17: IIR Filter, FIR Filter
Week 18: Final Exam
